fields.description: The delivery bot's Telegram token. Used for klik_pos's own direct outbound sends (driver-approved DM, booklet-stalled alert - Phase 8) and Telegram media downloads (Phase 6). Same bot/value as the Worker's BOT_TOKEN secret - kept in sync by hand, not pushed automatically.
fields.label: Bot Token

fields.description: Cloudflare account id (from the Cloudflare dashboard), scoping the KV namespace below.
fields.label: Cloudflare Account ID

fields.description: Cloudflare API token scoped to Workers KV (Edit permission on the DRIVERS namespace only - not a Global API Key). Used to PUT the approved-driver list on every relevant Delivery Driver save.
fields.label: Cloudflare API Token

fields.description: The Worker's DRIVERS KV namespace id (from `wrangler kv namespace create`, or the Cloudflare dashboard). The push target key within it is always `drivers:approved`.
fields.label: Cloudflare KV Namespace ID (DRIVERS)
